meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 当 Codex 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作后,插件会自动运行 comment-checker;若报出警告,Codex 会收到阻断性反馈,须先修复或解释被标记的注释再继续。
howto.when: 在编辑类工具调用成功之后触发;非编辑工具会被忽略;找不到 checker 程序时不产生钩子输出。

say.text: comment-checker 报了哪些警告?我该怎么改?
say.note: 它会说明被标记的注释并给出修改。

say.text: 这条注释警告是必须修,还是可以保留?
say.note: 它判断后给出修复或解释。

say.text: 先把注释问题处理掉,再继续改代码。
say.note: 它会先处理警告再往下走。

howto.what_en: After a successful Codex apply_patch, write, edit or similar call, the plugin runs comment-checker via a PostToolUse hook. If it warns, Codex gets blocking feedback and must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggered after a successful edit-like tool call (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.). Non-edit tools are ignored. If the checker binary is missing, no hook output is produced.

say_en.text: What did comment-checker warn about, and how should I fix it?
say_en.note: It explains the flagged comment and the fix.

say_en.text: Should I fix this comment warning, or can it stay?
say_en.note: It decides and suggests a fix or explanation.

say_en.text: Handle the comment warning before you keep editing.
